comments.author: SAI_Peregrinus
comments.story: FAA issues emergency directive on 2,000 Boeing 737 NG, Classic planes
comments.why: Custom lathe with under 1 micron tolerance
comments.text: Nanotech Systems (Moore's current name) make a high-precision drum lathe with 1nm positioning precision, with a 2600mm working area [1]. 1 part in 2,600,000,000. Dan Gelbart built his own lathe with <1µm final part tolerance [2]. Within a few thousandths of an inch isn't very impressive. I can hold 1 thou on a cheap manual lathe (Grizzly G0602 10"x22" working area), with a decent amount of care. Holding to tenths (1/10000") is impossible with the equipment I can afford though. [1] [LINK] [2] [VIDEO]
